entries.text: Fishing joins the Skills stone, and fish can be eaten from the pack
Continue now brings your Fishing level and your pools back
Water and its fishing spots now draw on the board
Selling a fish you cannot eat now pays your reward multiplier
Cast a line between waves and eat what you pull out
Every region now has water of its own colour
The map now deals water pools you can fish
The DPS stone's hitsplat icon sits straight in its stone
A snare now holds several enemies at once instead of spending every charge on the first one
Hunter trap details now show on hover during a wave
Dragging a sprite no longer leaves the board unclickable on Chrome
A leak now reads "Skeleton escaped, −1 life"
Each seed tile shows the buff it grows
Every price now carries the coin pile OSRS would draw for it
The inventory and the looting bag hold one size, and a piece's towers open over the bag
The farming patch picks a seed from a grid of herbs with a detail card
The backpack is the modern client's, ringed in stone with pale corner caps
Dragging on the board no longer freezes the game on Chrome
The looting bag is the inventory's last slot, and the backpack opens over its own stone
The bank is gone, and the inventory's 28 slots each hold one herb or one potion
The bank opens in its own window, and the Inventory wears the client's own frame
The inventory's tabs are the client's own stone buttons, red under the open page
The loot bag moves inside the Inventory, and the slots are the client's own
A ripe herb comes out of the ground whenever you click it, wave or no wave
An Inventory tab holds the 28 slots a run carries, and a bank takes whatever overflows
A ripe herb only comes out of the ground during a wave
The allotment is OSRS's own raked soil, baked edge to edge under the game's dirt texture, with a cut border a seed reads against
The Farming and Herblore lists scroll in their own boxes, and the Skills panel opens wide enough to read a whole recipe
The Overload lifts every tower at once, and charges a life at the end of every wave it is up
The potion that slows prayer drain is the real Prayer regeneration potion, brewed from a Super restore at 84
A plot's ripe glow and its countdown stay inside their own tile instead of sitting over whatever you built above it
The Herblore bench brews nineteen real OSRS potions, and each one only lifts the towers of its own style
Every tip, hint and boss caption now reads like a line somebody wrote
A tower's panel now names the herbs and potions boosting it, beside its prayers
Drinking a herb or potion that is already running now asks you to confirm first
Herbs stack like potions now, so a second one rides the wave alongside the first instead of replacing it
Traps are back to inventory size in the Hunter page instead of stretching across the row
The DPS and Skills stones swapped places on the bar
Herbs go into a pouch now, and a Herblore bench brews them into potions that last several waves
A Skills stone on the bar now gathers Hunter and Farming in one place
